title: English Practice Quiz 0967
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The idiom 'once in a blue moon' means ___.
questions.explanation: It describes something that happens very rarely.

questions.question: To 'look after' someone means to ___.
questions.explanation: Look after means care for or be responsible for someone.

questions.question: If you 'run out of' something, you ___.
questions.explanation: Run out of means use all of a supply.

questions.question: The phrase 'break the ice' means to ___.
options: make people feel more comfortable at the start
questions.explanation: It means ease initial awkwardness in a social situation.

questions.question: To 'put off' a meeting means to ___.
questions.explanation: Put off means delay or postpone.

questions.question: If someone says 'it's up to you', the decision is ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase gives another person the choice or responsibility.

questions.question: To 'carry on' means to ___.
questions.explanation: Carry on means continue doing something.

questions.question: The idiom 'a piece of cake' describes something ___.
questions.explanation: A piece of cake is an informal expression for an easy task.

questions.question: To 'find out' means to ___.
questions.explanation: Find out means discover or learn information.

questions.question: If you 'keep an eye on' something, you ___.
questions.explanation: Keep an eye on means monitor or watch carefully.
